content.description: Illustration showing hands inspecting the relief valve on an oil pump assembly

items.heading: INSPECT RELIEF VALVE
items.text: Check the relief valve for scoring or wear. If damaged, replace the valve or pump assembly.

content.description: Illustration showing hands using a feeler gauge to measure body clearance on oil pump

items.heading: MEASURE BODY CLEARANCE
items.text: Using a feeler gauge, measure the clearance between the driven gear and body.
items.note: If the clearance is greater than maximum, replace the gear and/or body.

content.description: Illustration showing hands using a feeler gauge to measure gear backlash on oil pump

items.heading: MEASURE GEAR BACKLASH
items.text: Using a feeler gauge, measure the backlash as shown.
items.note: If the blaklash is greater than maximum, replace the shaft subassembly and/or driven gear.

content.description: Illustration showing hands using a feeler gauge and flat block to measure side clearance on oil pump

items.heading: MEASURE SIDE CLEARANCE
items.text: Using a feeler gauge and flat block, measure the side clearance as shown.
items.note: If the clearance is greater than maximum, replace the gears and/or body.

content.description: Illustration showing hands assembling oil pump components with snap ring installation

items.label: (a)
items.text: Install the shaft subassembly, key, drive shaft gear, spacer and snap ring.

items.label: (b)
items.text: Install the driven gear and pump cover with five bolts.

items.label: (c)
items.text: Install the relief valve and spring in the cover and screw on the relief valve plug.
